image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a metallic chain with a warm, sepia-toned or golden hue. The image focuses on the interlocking links, highlighting their reflective surfaces and the complex geometry where they connect. The depth of field is shallow, causing the background links to blur while foreground links remain relatively sharp.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a chain and not a similar textured object like noodles or rope.
To verify that each link is a closed loop and properly interlocked without fusion or breaking.
To assess the realism of the metallic reflections and identify any subtle generation artifacts in the material properties.
To ensure the overlapping links have correct spatial relationships and no z-fighting or impossible intersections.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the links. AI often fails to render closed loops correctly, resulting in fused links or broken rings. Verify if the 'waxy' texture noted is an artifact of poor material rendering or just a stylistic choice. Ensure the depth cues align with the physical overlap of the links.
